title: Clay Extruder
pages: Craft the fifth t0 machine from iron ingots, Crusher-made copper grit, two pistons and a hopper. No Kiln output is needed.

Load one clay block to form one firebrick. This is the only source of Formed Firebrick; it replaces the upper-left plain brick in the Kiln craft. Stone and brick batches give 5 slabs per 2 blocks and 4 planks give 9 slabs, beating the stonecutter. Sandstone and cobbled deepslate stay at 2 slabs per block because reclamation would loop them.
Twenty datapack recipes use arcana_industry:extruding with ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. JEI lists the loaded recipes and the Extruder catalyst.
Supply FE, insert materials from top or sides, and extract below. Configure each face in the menu; inventory, FE, progress and ports save across reloads.
